description: Metadata for confirmed public Future of Privacy Forum pages about artificial intelligence, machine learning, or AI policy on fpf.org and www.fpf.org. www.fpf.org redirects to fpf.org. Each stored URL was confirmed with one bounded HTML GET. A Cloudflare challenge, a captcha, an authentication wall, a host that does not resolve, an HTTP error, a non-HTML body, a robots disallow, or an off-host redirect is omitted. Three resource pages redirected to a sign-in wall and are not stored. Person profiles, login pages, PDFs, and other hosts are omitted. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, publication date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A sole restricted deed keeps its own token. A missing publication date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. This catalog is not a belief collector and runner_wired is false.
